summary: Verified the date-editing bug fix end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed covering create-without-dates, 400 error when scheduling without dates, PUT persists dates, single-day scheduling with only start_date works, and all scheduled matches fall on the single day. Frontend Playwright: full flow passed — created tournament without dates, saw 'No dates set' amber badge, generated fixtures, got the date-error toast on Schedule Whole Tournament, opened Edit dialog with edit-tournament-btn, saved with only start_date (2026-05-10), header updated, re-ran scheduler (2 scheduled + 4 unfit due to legitimate single-day/single-ground capacity — not a bug), and date persisted after page reload.

issues: React console warning: 'value prop on input should not be null' — a constraints Input receives null for break_start/break_end/start_date. Should default to '' to keep it controlled.
Radix a11y warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby on DialogContent. Add a DialogDescription for each Dialog.

action_items: (Non-blocking) Fix controlled-input warning in ScheduleTab: coerce nullable constraint fields to '' before passing to <Input value=...>.
(Non-blocking) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Dialogs to remove Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_tournament accepts a raw Dict[str, Any] with no field whitelist — a client could set arbitrary keys (e.g., created_at, status) on the tournament. Consider a TournamentUpdate Pydantic model.

Dashboard.create() and TournamentDetail.saveEdit() both default end_date to start_date on the client. Backend also treats empty end_date as start_date in the scheduler, but PUT stores whatever the client sends. Single source of truth would be cleaner (either always normalize server-side or never at all).

server.py PUT /tournaments/{tid} does not verify the tournament exists before update_one — a bogus id silently updates 0 rows then get_or_404 correctly 404s, so behavior is fine but a first existence check would be more explicit.
seed_data_creation: All TEST_-prefixed data created during tests (tournaments, categories, teams, grounds). Module-scoped fixture deletes tournament (cascades) on teardown for backend tests. Frontend test leaves a TEST_UI_<id> tournament in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug-fix flow fully verified. Data-testids used: edit-tournament-btn, edit-start-date, edit-end-date, save-tournament-edit-btn, run-tournament-scheduler-btn. Single-day scheduling works (empty end_date -> uses start_date on backend). Only non-blocking React warnings remain (controlled input null + Dialog aria).
rca of the issue: Root cause was two-fold: (1) TournamentDetail lacked any Edit affordance so once created, dates could not be changed; (2) auto-schedule required both start and end even for single-day events. Fix adds edit-tournament-btn opening a Dialog that PUTs to /api/tournaments/{id}, and the schedule endpoint now falls back end_date=start_date when only start is set. Both branches confirmed via API tests and Playwright UI test.
